reason: Measures whether protagonist choices reveal character and carry costs -- core craft evidence of story quality.
Pure word-count of last paragraph; instruction explicitly ignores content or whether the ending lands.
Judges whether prose serves character/tension/theme versus boilerplate padding -- a craft judgment.
Rewards subverting or complicating genre convention -- an originality/craft judgment about the writing.
Measures reliance on borrowed IP/fandom material, a content-provenance fingerprint, not execution quality.
Distinguishes implied, embodied motive from flatly announced motive -- classic characterization craft.
Rewards selective, functional sensory detail over generic ornamentation -- a prose-craft judgment.
Assesses whether the ending crystallizes meaning versus being generic or abrupt -- craft evaluation.
Detects subreddit/moderation machinery displacing fiction -- platform apparatus, not a quality judgment.
Distinguishes fresh, apt phrasing from cliche stock diction -- direct sentence-craft evaluation.
Rewards context delivered through action/dialogue over inert explanatory passages -- structural craft.
Counts quotation marks only; instruction explicitly ignores whether dialogue is well written.
Estimates share of dialogue at story open, a purely structural/stylistic fingerprint with no quality judgment.
Counts references to prior/future installments -- a serial-format/platform marker, not story merit.
Measures mechanical spelling/formatting consistency, closer to a proofreading/authorship fingerprint than narrative craft.
Flags author's meta-commentary about experience or feedback requests -- not a property of the story.
Evaluates whether the piece completes a meaningful, earned arc -- structural narrative-quality judgment.
Judges whether stakes escalate irreversibly versus stalling or repeating -- plot-craft evaluation.
Rewards moral ambiguity left unresolved over pat lesson-delivery -- literary sophistication judgment.
Judges whether a twist is prepared by earlier evidence versus merely appended -- craft evaluation.
Detects explicit round/heat/bracket contest language -- platform contest formatting, not story merit.
Counts links, plugs, and feedback requests -- promotional platform furniture, not the story itself.
Judges whether a premise generates real conflict and meaning versus decorative mention -- craft judgment.
Rewards form that enacts the story's idea over generic default narration -- formal craft judgment.
Assesses distinctive, controlled character voice versus generic or gimmicky voice -- craft evaluation.
